content_text:
The less you have, the more important the quality of the story.
If you have extra money, put it in talented people, proper catering and solid sound. A worthwhile film can be done without any film lights or cinema camera if you’ve got the minds for creative solutions.
Limitation propels creativity.
If you start at zero, there’ll be limitations every minute of your way, so you want the right people on your side to make maximum use of these limitations. Good catering because bodies
and
minds must be fueled. Good sound because that’s the only thing the audience will not forgive if it’s bad.
